question:
Directions: Each item in this section consists of a sentence with an underlined word followed by four words/group of words. Select the option that is nearest in meaning to the underlined word and mark your response on the answer sheet accordingly.

They put in their sincere efforts and were lauded for their __endeavours.__
solution:
The correct answer is "**efforts**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• "**Endeavours**" generally means trying hard to do or achieve something. (प्रयास) 

 
 
• **Example**- He endeavours to keep his promises.
 
 
 
• "**Efforts**" is a synonym for endeavours, it signifies a vigorous attempt or striving. (मेहनत)
 
 
• **Example**- She put a lot of effort into finishing the project on time.
 
 
 
• Hence, the option that is similar in meaning to the given word is "Efforts".

Therefore, the correct answer is '**option 1**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• Let's have a look at the meanings of the remaining options.
 
• "**Passivity**" signifies acceptance of what happens, without active response or resistance. (निष्क्रियता)
 
• "**Fun**" refers to enjoyment, amusement, or lighthearted pleasure. (मनोरंजन)
 
• "**Drop**" means to let go of or release. (छोड़ना)
